notes: Teaching language quote is from the programme card of the Master in Finance on the GTK homepage, which does not explicitly name Engineering Management (BSc). The tuition quote is from the institution-wide Fee Structure page where the row reads "BSc Engineering Management 3200 2250" with column headers "Tuition Fee For non-EU citizens EUR/semester For EU citizens EUR/semester"; the numbers are not labeled per cell, so 3200 EUR/semester is inferred as the non-EU figure (listed first, matching the non-EU column header order). Application deadline/period on the programme page (1 April – 15 May) has no year stated and is not marked for international applicants, so no intake fact was included. The documents list on the admission page is explicitly marked "(for MSc)", and the same page separately lists Ph.D. documents; no document list specific to the BSc is given, so the MSc list is included here only as an interpretation of the general admission requirements. No duration in the pages describes the BSc Engineering Management programme.
